decisions.reason: Featured on the home page and central to the announced cloud messaging direction, so the firm's visible public commitment and investment make persistence very likely.
Its own dedicated page signals significant investment and fits the firm's electronic document workflow strategy, so any weak early results would be read as temporary ramp-up.
It builds on the core email and fax messaging expertise at low marginal cost, and dropping it would contradict the firm's multichannel positioning.
It is a feature close to the established fax business and cheap to maintain, though it is only lightly promoted and fax is a declining channel.
Sandbox threat protection is core to the security pillar the firm promotes, so its strategic centrality favours keeping it.
Multi-engine scanning sits close to the existing security offer and supports the firm's reliability claims, so dropping it brings little benefit.
